Description

Playing squash in London is a great way to keep fit and Harrow Leisure Centre in North West London has squash facilities available for hire. Sessions can be booked for one off games or, block book for a game every week and turn it in to a league. Squash rackets are available for hire at Harrow Leisure Centre but availability varies so we advise that you call the facility in advance to check. The squash courts here are incredible and the friendly staff and brilliantly maintained courts make it an excellent place for a game of squash.

Those driving are able to park free of charge at the facility. There are limited spaces available with weekends being particularly popular. The best parking availability is during the day and before 5pm.

Customers will be pleased to know that the venue operates a pay-as-you-play booking system. This means sports enthusiasts can just turn up and play depending on availability and book on a pay as you play basis. This method avoids the monthly membership charges and gives you the freedom to play as and when you like, without the commitment of a weekly game or a membership fee.

If a one-off game isn't enough, then why not take advantage of the block booking option at Harrow Leisure Centre? Block bookings are a great way to guarantee a weekly game and socialise with your friends. It also takes the hassle out of paying before each game and collecting money from teammates as there is a one-time payment.

The closest station when travelling is Harrow and Wealdstone. The facility is located a short walk from here - for more details on how to access the facility please contact the venue.
